verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own API docs state that its Cloud APIs can be used through client libraries in popular programming languages, and its API versioning and 12-month deprecation commitments give a stable base to build against. The evidence is a thin, repeated one-line mention rather than detailed SDK documentation. Missing for 10: named list of supported SDK languages, SDK install and reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
